title: Clinic support must respect operational windows
trigger: An authorized operator accepts a relevant request or scheduled obligation into the shared workflow.
preconditions: Record operational impact using non-patient information; identify the authorized coordinator and approved work window; retain monitoring follow-up.
Verify customer-specific permissions, identities, rules and system integration support.
